chapter.verse: Kihilhhilh napi-a a mang nuam lote, bawl phatkik zawh nawn loh dongin kisia ding hi.
Midikte in gam a uk ciangin gam mite lungdam a, migilote in a uk ciangin a gam mite thuum uh hi.
Pilna a deih mi in a pa lungdamsak a, numei paktat tawh a kikhawl mi in a neihsa teng lawnmang hi.
Thuman-a a gamta kumpi in a gam kipsak a, sum bek a ngaihsun kumpipa in a gam siasak hi.
A man lopi-a mi khat mawk phatna in, a awk nadingin thangsiahna ahi hi.
Migilote, amau’ mawhna sungah awkcip a, midikte ahih leh suakta-in lungdam uh hi.
Midikte in mi cimawhte’ ading thu khual a, migilote in tua bang khualna thei lo uh hi.
Thu a khual lote in khua sungah buaina lianpi piangsak a, mipilte in tua buaina dai sak thei hi.
Mipil khat in mihai khat tawh zum-ah thu nei leh, mipilpa tungah hehin zahko a, phattuamna piang tuan lo hi.
Mi a that nuamte in a thuman mi mudah a, midikte in a thuman mi hu uh hi.
Mihaipa a hehna bangin kampau-in gamta gawp a, mipilpa ahih leh ki-ip-in a hehna dam sak hi.
Kumpipa in zuauthu saang-in na sem leh, a nuai-a ulian khempeuh zong zuau genin nitum ding hi.
Mizawngpa leh mi bawlsiapa a kibatna uh khat om hi— Topa in a nih tuak-un mittang guan hi.
Kumpipa in mizawngte’ thu a manin khensak leh, a ukna kip tawntung ding hi.
Ciangduai leh taina in pilna guan’ a, a kikhahkhong ta in a nu maizum sak hi.
Migilote ulian suak leh siatna khang semsem a, ahi zongin midikte in amau’ mit mahmah tawh, a gilo uliante’ za kiatna mu ding uh hi.
Na ta thuhilhin tai lecin, ama hangin na kipak ding a, na lung hong kimsak ding hi.
Pasian’ lamlahna a kizuih lohna gam-ah, gamsung mite phengtat uh a, Pasian’ thukham a zui mite a lungdam hi.
Kam-a hilh lel tawh silate pil zo lo a, a theih hangin hong mang tuan lo hi.
Thu ngaihsun lo-a pheng paupau mipa sangin, mihaipa adingin lametna om zawlai hi.
Sila khat a neu tunga-a kipan lim takin na khoi hangin, a tawpna-ah nang hong hehsak veve ding hi.
A heh pahpahte in kitotna piangsak a, a heh baihte khial thei tawntung hi.
A kiphasakte in niamkhiatna thuak ding a, a kiniamkhiatte in pahtawina ngah ding hi.
Guktakna sunga kipawl mipa, ama adingin thusia zongpa ahi hi. A guktakna pulak leh daan kitat ding a, genkhia kei leh lah kisamsia veve ding hi.
Midangte kihtakna in hong lunghimawhsak a, Topa muan’na in hong lungmuangsak hi.
Mi khempeuh in gam ukte’ maipha ngah ding hanciam uh a, ahi zongin Topa kiang pan bekin thutang kingah hi.
Midikte in migilote mudah a, migilote in midikte mudah hi.
